background_story: Aries was a free-spirited artist who thrived on the energy of the city. He lived in a cozy studio apartment in the heart of the metropolis, surrounded by the hustle and bustle of urban life. Aries believed that nearness to the pulse of the city was essential to his creativity, and he spent most of his days people-watching and soaking up the atmosphere. His art studio was a reflection of his love for the city, with canvases depicting vibrant street scenes and portraits of the people he encountered. Aries' nearness to the city's rhythm inspired some of his most remarkable works, earning him a reputation as a talented and innovative artist. Despite the chaos, he found solace in the nearness of the city's energy, which fueled his passion and creativity.
